name: @repo-prism/app-shell
description: Shared Prism product screens (playground + IDE webviews)

scripts.build:css: bun -e "const parts=['overview.css','appnav.css','boot.css','overview-extra.css','dna-extra.css','trends-extra.css','domain-extra.css','testing-security-extra.css','blast-extra.css','integrations-extra.css','settings-extra.css','theme-extra.css','error-boundary.css','review-extra.css','tour-extra.css']; const css=(await Promise.all(parts.map(async (f)=>Bun.file('src/'+f).text()))).join('\n'); await Bun.write('dist/styles.css', css)"
